title: Emphatic
summary: EMPHAT'IC EMPHAT'ICAL, adjective Forcible; strong; impressive; as an emphatic voice, tone or pronunciation; emphatical reasoning. 1. Requiring emphasis; as an emphatical word. 2. Uttered with emphasis

inlines.v: EMPHAT'IC EMPHAT'ICAL, adjective Forcible; strong; impressive; as an emphatic voice, tone or pronunciation; emphatical reasoning. 1. Requiring emphasis; as an emphatical word. 2. Uttered with emphasis. We remonstrated in emphatical terms. 3. Striking to the eye; as emphatic colors.
